Sycamore Lighting is a leading manufacturer and supplier of cutting-edge LED lighting and control systems, specialising in the Kitchens, Bathroom and Bedroom lighting sectors.

JOB PURPOSE

To support our technical, customer service, quality and compliance activities. This role is ideal for someone with strong administrative and customer service skills who is keen to develop their technical knowledge.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Customer & Technical Support
- Respond to customer technical enquiries via telephone and email.
- Manage the technical support inbox.
- Provide basic technical advice and product guidance.
- Maintain records of customer enquiries and resolutions.

Quotations & Contract Support
- Prepare customer quotations accurately and promptly.
- Support project quotations and contract enquiries.
- Coordinate delivery requirements with the Operations team.

Customer Service & Account Support
- Support key account customers with day-to-day enquiries.
- Monitor forecasts and delivery schedules.
- Review shortages, service issues and credit requests.
- Help maintain high levels of customer satisfaction.

Quality & Compliance Support
- Maintain technical files, certificates and product records.
- Assist with declarations of conformity and test reports.
- Support WEEE and packaging compliance submissions.
- Liaise with suppliers to obtain compliance documentation.

Product Testing & Quality
- Assist with product testing and ageing programmes.
- Maintain quality records and testing documentation.
- Support investigations into product issues and complaints.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Customer service, technical support or administration experience.
- Excellent communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Competent with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.

Desirable Experience
- Electrical, lighting or manufacturing experience or similar.
- Quotation preparation experience.
- Knowledge of compliance documentation or quality procedures.

title: Clerical Officer/Receptionist
description: The Outpatient Administration team work in collaboration with the Referral and Booking Service, Outpatient Nursing, Switchboard, Phlebotomy and the Robotic Process Automation teams. Together we form the Outpatient Clinical Service Unit. The Outpatient Administration team are based across five sites Leeds General Infirmary, Chapel Allerton Hospital, Seacroft Hospital, Wharfedale Hospital and St James University Hospital; and two Community Diagnostic Centres at Beeston and Armley. The main duty of this role is to provide administration support to the Outpatient clinics at Seacroft Hospital. The administration support includes computer-based work using our Patient Administration System and providing front of house reception support, delivering a high standard of patient care. Our Clerical Officer team ensure all paperwork and systems are prepared in advance of Outpatient appointments. They also provide receptionist support across a number of reception areas; book patient appointments in person and by telephone; and ensure all post clinic actions are completely timely. The main attributes we are looking for include being motivated, reliable, trustworthy, flexible, and keen to learn. We are also seeking somebody who is a good team player, with the ability to work on their own initiative. We are proud of the diversity within our teams, welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to recruiting inclusively. This provides a varied working environment, opportunities to develop a wide skill set, and valuable exposure to different specialties, services and different ways of working across the Trust. It is an exciting time within the Outpatient Administration team as we introduce more digital ways of working and support the Trust’s commitment to sustainability by reducing paper use. title: Care Navigator/Receptionist
description: Due to a member of the team upskilling into a new role, we are seeking a Care Navigator/Receptionist to join our fast-paced reception and administration team. We are looking for individuals who feel they will be able to settle into a busy practice, whilst able to work independently and as part of a team. Previous primary care or GP surgery experience is desirable, although applicants with relevant transferable skills will also be considered. Provide a professional and welcoming first point of contact for patients, visitors and healthcare professionals. Manage a busy telephone system, responding to enquiries and directing patients to the most appropriate service. Book, amend and cancel patient appointments in accordance with practice protocols. Receive patients at the reception desk, recording arrivals and assisting with enquiries. Process repeat prescription requests in line with practice procedures. Deal with incoming emails, post and other administrative correspondence. Liaise effectively with GPs, nurses, pharmacists, hospitals and other healthcare organisations. Carry out administrative tasks relating to patient records, including scanning, document management and filing. Follow practice protocols to ensure consistent and high-quality care is provided to our patients. Act as directed by other members of the practice team. Provide reception and administrative cover for colleagues during periods of annual leave or sickness absence. Work across both Ireland Wood and Horsforth practice sites when required. Ensure confidentiality is always maintained in accordance with General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and practice policies. The Care Navigator/Receptionist is an essential member of the practice team, providing a professional, efficient and patient-focused reception and administrative service across both practice sites. Working closely with the Practice Manager, GP Partners and the wider clinical and administrative teams, the post-holder will help ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the practice while delivering excellent customer service to patients and visitors. A key part of the role is supporting patients with their queries and appointment requests, helping them to access the most appropriate healthcare professional or service in line with practice protocols. The post-holder will manage appointments, respond to telephone and face-to-face enquiries, process repeat prescription requests and undertake a range of administrative duties to support the delivery of safe and effective patient care. The role also includes maintaining accurate patient records, processing correspondence and supporting communication with hospitals, pharmacies and other healthcare organisations. The post-holder will work in accordance with practice policies, maintain confidentiality at all times, and provide cover for colleagues and across both practice sites when required. Overall, this is a varied and rewarding role that requires excellent communication, organisational and IT skills, together with the ability to work calmly and effectively in a busy environment while providing a high standard of patient care and customer service.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: We are looking to appoint a receptionist to join our busy GP practice based over two sites, who will be the first point of contact for patients and visitors as well as carrying out general office management tasks. You will be responsible for the general reception duties within the Practice and work with our established processes, policies and procedures to provide a comprehensive high quality service and deal efficiently and courteously with patient enquiries. You will receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. You will provide general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone. You will have excellent communication skills, a compassionate and friendly nature who can operate in a busy environment working with a range of people. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organised and an effective communicator who can provide a professional and warm welcome to our patients, ensuring every contact is of the highest quality. To have a thorough knowledge of all practice procedures. Computer data entry, processing and recording information in accordance with practice procedures. Providing clerical assistance to practice staff as required, including word/data processing, electronic filing, photocopying, and scanning. Cover sickness/annual leave and work reasonable overtime when required. Receiving patients, consulting with members of the practice team. Processing prescription requests from patients, dealing with prescriptions queries from patients and pharmacies. Be able to cover all reception positions as necessary. Taking messages and passing on information. Processing personal and telephone requests for appointments, telephone consultations and home visits and ensuring callers are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional. Processing and distributing incoming (and outgoing) mail. Ensure that system is operational at the beginning of each day and switched over to night service and that the answer phone is operational at the end of each day. Keeping the reception area and notice boards tidy and free from obstructions and ensuring patient information and leaflets are well stocked. Maintaining and monitoring the practice and extended access appointments system including booking/amending and cancelling appointments, ensuring sufficient and accurate information is recorded. Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and associated healthcare agencies and providers. Filing and retrieving paperwork. Scanning clinical correspondence onto SystmOne. APPOINTMENT SYSTEM MANAGEMENT Monitor effectiveness of the system and report any problems or variations required. CONSULTATION ROOM PREPARATIONS Consulting rooms checked, prepared and re-stocked daily in readiness for each consulting session in accordance with Practice guidelines. Ensuring the practice is left tidy and secure and rooms are checked and re-stocked in line with Practice guidelines at the end of each day.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: Abbey Grange Medical Practice is looking for a part time receptionist to join our friendly experienced team on a fixed term 12 month contract with a view to the position continuing after the fixed term period. The successful applicant will be working 24 hours per week over 4 days. Primary frontline contact for patients, managing patient access, communications, and administrative workflows within the practice including: Greeting and Check-in Telephone Management Care Navigation Prescription Processing Data Entry & Records Correspondence & Post New Patient Registrations Job Summary: - To assist patients both face-to-face and on the telephone with booking appointments, requests for information or access to other services provided by the practice. - To work as an effective member of the reception team ensuring that all day-to-day delegated tasks are administered to agreed timescales. - To maintain an effective patient recall system for chronic disease management. - To provide general admin duties as required Main Duties and Responsibilities: Reception - To greet patients and direct them as appropriate, maintaining a high level of professionalism at all times. - Ensure patients are checked in when arriving for appointments on the appointment system. - Signpost patients to the correct clinician or service - Accepting requests for and handing out repeat prescriptions. - Handing out letters, completed forms etc., accepting the appropriate fee and issuing a receipt. - Registration of new patients and temporary residents. - Explaining about surgery procedures. - Keeping the waiting room clean and tidy. Telephone - Receive incoming calls and deal with queries appropriately and professionally. - Record all messages in the appropriate manner according to the practice policy & workflow. - Take details of visits in accordance with practice procedure. - Order ambulances when required. - Contact & liaise with patients delivering information and messages as instructed by the GP including informing patients of test results. Computer - To book appointments or amend when required - Raise and issue repeat prescriptions in accordance with practice procedures - Scan hospital letters and other correspondence into the clinical system ensuring that they are attached to the correct patient record. - To use the choose & book system for patient choice referrals - Maintain a recall system in accordance with practice procedure for calling in patients for routine review. - General administrative duties as requested by the practice manager or admin manager Confidentiality : In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately. In the performance of the duties outlined in this Job Description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, practice staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential. Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data. Health & Safety : The post-holder will assist in promoting and maintaining their own and others health, safety and security as defined in the practice Health & Safety Policy, to include: Using personal security systems within the workplace according to practice guidelines. Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills. Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way and free from hazards. Reporting potential risks

The role requires extensive use of Microsoft Office applications such as Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Are you passionate about making a difference? title: GP Receptionist / Care Navigator
description: We are recruiting for a Care Navigator to join our team. The role will be part time, and you must be available to work Friday evenings up until 18:30pm. Working within the Robin Lane reception team, the post-holder will help provide a friendly and welcoming service for all patients. The Care Navigator will support patients to access the right health care in a professional and efficient manner. Follow practice processes to actively signpost patients to the most appropriate healthcare professional and service, whilst handling any complex queries and challenging situations in a professional manner, ensuring any issues are resolved where possible, at the first point of contact. Assist both clinical and admin colleagues with the smooth running of the reception area and surgery building.The post-holder is expected to comply with the employment policies and procedures, with due regard to clinical and information governance policies and procedures, and any other policies and procedures necessary for the safe and effective discharge of the duties contained within this document. This job description is subject to a flexibility clause and may change according to business requirements. This advert may close early should the right candidate be found. To welcome patients presenting either in person or by telephone; ensuring you respond promptly and positively. Book appointments for patients and cancel appointments where needed. Support patients in navigating to the most appropriate service, which may include informing patients of external health care providers and online services. Effectively handle all queries that present at the practice; problem solving, signposting and escalation of matters, as appropriate. Ensure patient records are accurate and kept up to date and that all patient contacts are documented in the system using the Care Navigation Template. Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and associated healthcare providers. Carrying out administrative duties which include scanning, tasks, out of hours reports, new patient registrations (including basic urine dip), opening and sorting of post (both internal and external), photocopying reports, updating patient details, filing INR reports and data inputting as requested. Processing medication requests, including issuing repeat medication and appliance items, as well as forwarding patient requests onto the practice pharmacy team/on-call GP. Communicating effectively with local pharmacy staff and resolving/investigating any queries they may have. Processing e-consults via system one and triaging the patient accordingly using signposting where necessary. Opening up/locking up of practice premises and maintaining security in accordance with practice protocols. Carry out chronic disease recalls and vaccination campaigns, booking relevant appointments working from a list to ensure clinics are fully utilised Informing patients of test results and following up with instructions from clinicians. Keeping the reception area and notice boards clean, tidy and up to date. Taking payments for private documents from patients and providing receipts Support all clinical staff with general tasks as required. Assisting the Site Co-ordinator with weekly fire alarm checks and weekly/monthly legionella testing, when required. Assisting the Site Co-ordinator with weekly room plans and petty cash records, when required. To be able to work with people from a wide variety of cultures and backgrounds, and people with disabilities and learning difficulties, and to be able to communicate with them (and, when necessary, their carers) appropriately to facilitate their care and understanding of their care within the service. Attend and positively contribute to team meetings. Fully comply with all company Health and Safety requirements, including reporting all accidents, near accidents, and hazards. Treat all patients fairly and with respect. Provide cover across all sites as required. This is not an exhaustive list, and it is expected that this role will develop as the business grows.
